title: SPARK & WOW Caterpillar Activity Wall Panels (Open Box)

comparisons.notes: Spark & Wow Caterpillar Activity Wall Panel, SKU W-5823, MPN 44557, 5 panels, 8 activities, 73in L x 29.25in H. Page says in stock (also tagged nonstock, may ship from maker).

writeup: Woot has an open-box Spark & Wow Caterpillar activity wall for $26.84. It's a five-panel busy board with eight hands-on activities that stretches about 73 inches long, the kind used in daycares and playrooms. Shields Childcare Supplies sells the same panel set for $217, so this is about 87% under the cheapest store we found. Woot showed only 1 left.
